Mistress '''Cinchonine''' is the innkeeper of [[The Crown of Roses]] in [[Caemlyn]]. She is very round {{ref/book|6|43}}.
==Activities==
She accommodates [[Merana]], as she has done often before, and brings her and the other [[Aes Sedai]] tea {{ref/book|6|43}}.

She surveys the common room and wears a sour expression, because there are too little visitors buying wine or ale{{ref/book|6|49}}.
